# Arch-loop follow-up row J -- PLA, nozzle 205C, bed 60C, M221 S100

**Not yet print-tested.** Generated by `arch_test.mjs ... J`. Printed on the **same bed** as `20261029_arch-loop-8-rows-PLA.gcode` -- don't clear the sheet. Row J sits at Y=151, above row I (Y 137).

Calibration line: `freeformSolid` x=120-180, y=35, printed first (the next free step in the calibration sequence; y=75 from the 8-row print and y=40 from row I are already on this bed). `verifyLayout` against everything already on the bed (3mm min gap): ok=true, 0 warnings.

**Change from row I** (everything else identical: H 3, S 3, 6 loops, same anchors, fan on):

| | row I | row J |
|---|---|---|
| arch strand e/d (rise, bridge, descent) | 0.075 | 0.075 (same) |
| rise / bridge / descent F (mm/min) | 150 / 150 / 200 | 75 / 75 / 100 |
| filament per loop's bridge (mm) | 0.225 | 0.225 |
| time on the bridge (s) | 1.2 | 2.4 |
| melt flow while bridging (mm3/s) | 0.45 | 0.23 |

Same strand thickness as row I, but each part of the strand now spends twice as long under the fan before the nozzle moves away. Melt flow per second halves again.

**No purge line**: the header's purge lines at X10-10.4, Y15-100 are left out (they would print on top of the ones already there). The calibration line is the first extrusion, so it doubles as the prime -- expect its start to be a little thin.

| row | Y | shape | dir | H (mm) | S (mm) | loops | pitch gap | rise / bridge / down F | top dwell | fan | ~mm3/s at bridge | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| J | 151 | staple | x | 3.0 | 3.0 | 6 | 3.0 | 75 / 75 / 100 | - | on | 0.23 | row I's strand (e/d 0.075) with every arch move at half of row I's speed again (a quarter of row B's) |

**What to look for**: compare directly with row I (Y=137). Does the bridge stay level instead of sagging? Does the extra time under the fan make the bridge straighter than row I's, or has it stopped improving? At this low flow, does the strand stay continuous, or does it thin out or break mid-bridge? Any blobs where the nozzle sits at the top corners?

Totals: 1388 G-code lines, 11.5 mm commanded filament.
